blender.name: The graveyard
blender.detail: tombstones (round, gothic, cross, small), dirt mounds, an iron fence and a creaking double gate, a dead tree with crooked branches, a crypt with a hinged door, lamp posts, rocks, skulls and glowing mushrooms — all original, modelled with Blender's Python API

blender.name: Halloween things
blender.detail: a giant pumpkin and its patch, a coffin mailbox with a hinged lid, a witch's cauldron on a fire, a haunted gramophone, a jack-o'-lantern candy bucket, an old box camera on a tripod, candles, bats, crows and the haunted mansion — all original

original: Made for this project, in its own storybook-toon look: the moonlit hill and its sky, the fog and will-o'-wisps, lightning, the carved-pumpkin name, the hanging polaroids, the rising plan stones and crypt plaque, the cauldron and its brew, the cartoon ghosts, the bat heart round the moon, the spirit photograph and its poster, fireworks, and all synthesised sounds and music.
